_about: AFFALTER S EXECUTIVE (Maybach S-Class W223): the driver display and the portrait centre screen are blank in the model (black patches of the interior texture, on its own faces), so each gets a board laid on it, measured from its faces (rays from the driver's eye; m from the steering wheel's centre, the model's axes: x right, y up, z back): the classic two-dial view in rose gold on the driver display, the map and media pages on the centre screen (tilted back as the real one). Ambient lighting: warm white-gold, as the Maybach's.
